audience: Adult learners; adjust episode audience explicitly in CONFIG.
boundary: Population-level evidence and systems; exclude individual medical advice.
production_handoff: Provide cited narration, timed scene directions, continuity references and generation prompts for the user's external AI video workflow. No audiovisual generation pilot is required.

topics.title: Population exposure evidence
topics.coverage: A historical evaluation and its outcome definitions.
topics.exclusions: Individual diagnosis or current prevalence estimates.
topics.evidence_required: Original methods, tables and inference limits.
topics.next_action: Resolve recorded idea gaps in Phase 1 before drafting narration.

topics.title: Sampling and representativeness
topics.coverage: Eligibility, recruitment and the target population.
topics.next_action: Resolve recorded idea gaps in Phase 1 before drafting narration.

topics.title: Measurement and missing data
topics.coverage: One measurement procedure and handling of incomplete information.
topics.exclusions: Invented individual measurements or unperformed reanalysis.
topics.next_action: Resolve recorded idea gaps in Phase 1 before drafting narration.

topics.title: Surveillance and case definitions
topics.coverage: One reporting system, population and definition version.
topics.exclusions: Equating notifications with all underlying cases.
topics.next_action: Choose a bounded case and inspect primary source availability before adding an episode idea.

topics.title: Intervention evaluation
topics.coverage: Comparison design, time trends and alternative explanations.
topics.exclusions: Causal certainty from an uncontrolled comparison.
topics.next_action: Choose a bounded case and inspect primary source availability before adding an episode idea.

topics.title: Health communication
topics.coverage: Absolute quantities, uncertainty and audience comprehension.
topics.evidence_required: Checked denominators and evidence on interpretation.
topics.next_action: Choose a bounded case and inspect primary source availability before adding an episode idea.

topics.title: Equity and distribution
topics.coverage: Differences between groups, access and measurement coverage.
topics.evidence_required: Disaggregated data with collection and disclosure limits.
topics.next_action: Choose a bounded case and inspect primary source availability before adding an episode idea.

topics.title: Community prevention systems
topics.coverage: One documented prevention program and implementation context.
topics.exclusions: Medical advice or invented local outcomes.
topics.evidence_required: Program documentation, evaluation and community context.
topics.next_action: Choose a bounded case and inspect primary source availability before adding an episode idea.

series.title: Reading a public-health evaluation
series.entry_requirement: No prior episode required; explain specialist terms on first use.
series.learning_outcome: Ask what was measured, who was included and how measurement limits were handled.
series.ordering_reason: First identify the question, then the sample, then the measurement assumptions.
